clue.text: A shade cowardly

parts.note: read as 'a little bit lily-livered' the clue describes a coward-ish manner, but it is also simply a pale colour near gold

explanation.surface: Someone is described as slightly lacking in courage.
explanation.walkthrough: The -ISH suffix does both jobs: a colour that is a tint of the coward's colour, and 'somewhat cowardly'.
explanation.definitionFit: A tint close to the colour of lemons and butter is a shade; yellow also means lacking courage.

clue.text: An outdated law, to be precise

parts.note: ex means former, no longer current
an act is a statute passed by Parliament

explanation.surface: Someone pedantically cites a statute that has been repealed.
explanation.definitionFit: Being precise means being accurate and correct in every detail.

clue.text: The Italian rose is reproduced with fewer restrictions

parts.note: lo is one form of the definite article in Italian

indicators.note: reproduced in a new form, so the letters of the flower's name are rearranged

explanation.surface: An Italian rose variety is being propagated more freely.
explanation.definitionFit: Something less tight or less constrained is under fewer restrictions.

clue.text: You and I confront a wicked little pest

parts.note: the speaker plus the person addressed together make us, the first person plural
evil is a synonym for wicked

explanation.surface: Two people face down a nasty small creature in the garden.
explanation.definitionFit: A beetle that bores into grain and plants is a small destructive insect.

clue.text: A full-bodied drink

definitions.meaning: describing a person who is plump or heavily built
a dark strong beer brewed with roasted malt

explanation.definitionFit: A portly person is described as heavily built; a dark beer like porter is the drink.

clue.text: Telling it straight in the language of the Low Countries

definitions.meaning: speaking frankly and bluntly, without euphemism

definitions.text: the language of the Low Countries
definitions.meaning: read literally, the talk of flat lowland regions, the lowlands being level ground

explanation.walkthrough: 'Low Countries' suggests the Netherlands and Dutch, but here it just means flat land.
explanation.definitionFit: Frank talk is candid; flat lowlands are plains, so their talk is their speech.

clue.text: I enter the portraits with feelings of misgiving

indicators.note: the single letter goes inside the word for the pictures, entering it

parts.note: presentments are representations or pictures, as in Hamlet's 'counterfeit presentment of two brothers'

explanation.surface: Someone walks into a gallery of portraits feeling uneasy.
explanation.definitionFit: Forebodings are intuitive senses that something bad will happen.

clue.text: Everything on the table is there for everyone to see

parts.note: all means the whole lot
above board means openly, not hidden, as cards kept above a card table

explanation.surface: A poker player insists everything laid out on the table is open for inspection.
explanation.definitionFit: Something honest and open is visible to all, hiding nothing.

clue.text: Material evidence that the apostle saved his bacon?

definitions.meaning: a thick corded ribbon used to stiffen waistbands and hats

definitions.text: evidence that the apostle saved his bacon?
definitions.meaning: read as the gammon belonging to St Peter, his ham

explanation.definitionFit: A corded ribbon fabric is a textile; Peter's ham would be the saved bacon.

clue.text: Resolve to discourage excavation

parts.note: to deter is to put someone off
a mine is a pit dug into the ground

explanation.surface: Someone is determined to stop a dig going ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: To resolve is to decide firmly or to settle a question.

clue.text: Priest and Old Testament poet

parts.note: Eli was the priest who raised Samuel in the Bible

explanation.surface: A clergyman and the Hebrew scriptures share a sentence with a writer of verse.
explanation.definitionFit: T. S. Eliot, author of The Waste Land, was a famous writer of verse.

clue.text: Set a test to see how good the food is

definitions.text: to see how good the food is

indicators.note: set in a new order, so the letters of the two words are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A chef's exam is set to judge the quality of a dish.
explanation.definitionFit: To sample a dish by eating a little is to judge its flavour.

clue.text: Dry old penny piece of bread

parts.note: d was the abbreviation for a penny in pre-decimal British money
a roll is a small loaf of bread

explanation.surface: A stale coin and a bit of bread are listed together.
explanation.definitionFit: Dry humour is wry and quietly amusing.

clue.text: Preliminary plan for conscription in the States

definitions.meaning: a first rough version of a document or scheme
the American term for compulsory military call-up

explanation.definitionFit: A rough first version is a sketch; Americans called up for service faced compulsory enlistment.

clue.text: Working film actors are there from the beginning

parts.note: on means operating or in action
a set is where a film is shot, where the actors perform

explanation.surface: The cast have been working on location from day one.
explanation.definitionFit: The start or commencement of something is its beginning.

clue.text: The revolutionary character of Hutton's batting

parts.note: Len Hutton was a great England cricket batsman of the 1930s-50s
in cricket the side batting is said to be in

explanation.surface: A commentator remarks on the rebellious style of a cricketer's innings.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir Len Hutton was an England cricket captain; in cricket a batsman at the crease is 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bolshevik leader of the Russian Revolution of 1917 is the revolutionary.

clue.text: English flower festival

parts.note: an aster is a daisy-like garden flower

explanation.surface: A flower show held in England.
explanation.definitionFit: The Christian feast of the Resurrection is a spring festival.

clue.text: Show EEC arrangements to store French wine

indicators.note: the shuffled letters hold the wine inside them, storing it
arrangements of the three capitals, so they are put in a fresh order

parts.note: vin is the French word for wine

explanation.surface: A display of European Economic Community rules on keeping wine in storage.
explanation.walkthrough: EEC looks like the old European trading bloc, but it is just three letters to shuffle around the wine.
explanation.definitionFit: To evince is to display or reveal a quality clearly.

clue.text: Firing a clergyman who loses his head

indicators.note: the word for the cleric drops its first letter, its head

parts.note: a parson is a parish priest

explanation.surface: A vicar is sacked after losing his temper.
explanation.definitionFit: Setting fire to property deliberately is the crime of fire-raising.

clue.text: Say farewell personally to a diocesan official

parts.note: a see is the area under a bishop's authority, a diocese
off is an abbreviation of official

explanation.surface: A bishop's administrator is given a personal send-off.
explanation.definitionFit: To accompany someone to their departure point is to bid them goodbye in person.

clue.text: One of the company is physically frail

definitions.meaning: read literally, someone who is inside a business, within the firm
weak in body, especially through age or illness

explanation.definitionFit: Being within a firm makes one an employee; an infirm person is weak through age or illness.

clue.text: A bird with an enormous body

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird

explanation.surface: A small bird somehow has a huge body.
explanation.definitionFit: A giant of legend, or Saturn's largest moon, is a huge body.

clue.text: Where to find campers concentrated

definitions.meaning: read literally, people camping are inside canvas shelters

explanation.definitionFit: Campers sleep under canvas; someone intent is fixed and absorbed on a goal.

clue.text: A Vice Admiral and sailor of godly nature

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for Vice Admiral
tar is an old word for a sailor

explanation.surface: A naval officer and a seaman are described as divinely inspired.
explanation.definitionFit: In Hindu belief a deity's incarnation in earthly form is a manifestation of the divine.

clue.text: Like the famous botanical gardens after the hurricane?

parts.note: as means in the manner of
Kew Gardens in west London are the Royal Botanic Gardens

explanation.surface: A storm has wrecked the famous gardens in London.
explanation.walkthrough: Kew Gardens is the Royal Botanic Gardens in London; trees after a storm are left crooked.
explanation.definitionFit: After a storm, everything is left crooked and out of line.

clue.text: To maintain a correspondence is utterly right

indicators.note: uttered, that is spoken out, so the word is taken by how it is said

parts.note: the word right, said out loud

explanation.surface: Keeping up letters is declared to be entirely correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'utterly' looks like 'completely' but is read as 'when uttered', signalling a homophone.
explanation.definitionFit: Keeping up letters with someone means sending them letters.

clue.text: The part of the ship that looks forbidding

definitions.meaning: the rear end of a vessel
describing a face that is severe and strict

explanation.definitionFit: The back of a vessel is its aft end; a severe expression is harsh and grim.

clue.text: Spring in a Mediterranean country

parts.note: a spa is a mineral spring

explanation.surface: Springtime in a sunny southern country.
explanation.definitionFit: The Iberian kingdom with Madrid as capital borders the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Dear Sir-Isn't it upsetting to be facing horrendous problems?

indicators.note: upsetting overturns these words, so their letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: An indignant letter to the editor complains about something distressing.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in serious trouble or great difficulty is the idiom's meaning.

clue.text: Peach and honey in the East

parts.note: nectar is the sweet liquid bees make honey from, and a word for anything sweet
E is the abbreviation for East

explanation.surface: A peach and honey in an oriental dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A smooth-skinned variety of peach is a fruit.
